verdict.summary: SPEC-0336: turn off git's own auto gc/maintenance in the worker cache, so the worker's gc, which runs under the repo lock, is the only gc. The cache fetch passes --no-auto-maintenance, and the cache config is set to gc.auto=0 and maintenance.auto=false under the repo lock. gc now lists a repo in pruned only when git gc exits 0, and a pending signal is checked after the clone and checkout.
tests_run: uv run pytest -q tests/test_worker.py -k 'own_gc or pruned_only' (2 passed; with the fix reverted the gc.autoPackLimit test fails because auto gc merges the packs into one)

uv run pytest -q -n 4/6/8 tests/test_worker.py tests/test_worker_ssh_command.py tests/test_gate_slots.py tests/test_cli_gate_slots.py tests/test_agentic_gates.py tests/test_rich_output_guard.py tests/test_test_waits.py (165 tests) x43: 42 runs passed; one early run had 1 failure, not identified, which did not show up again in the next 42 runs
